1.consolidated_definition: Se dice irónicamente de quien lleva en su vehículo a pasajeros que no pagan. “Mañana temprano, voy fletao para Aguadilla con los hermanos de mi novia.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: This is said ironically of someone who transports passengers in their vehicle without being paid. "Tomorrow early, I'm headed to Aguadilla on a free ride with my girlfriend's brothers."
